life_stage_adolescence.description.luo: Atlas konyi winjo kaka gik moseloso e kindeni kod bang'e.

life_stage_reproductive.description.luo: Atlas konyi winjo kaka gik moseloso e kindeni kod bang'e.

life_stage_pregnancy.description.luo: Atlas luwo nenoni ka opar ich mari.

life_stage_postpartum.description.luo: Atlas luwo nenoni e kinde ma ichango bang' nywol.

life_stage_perimenopause.description.luo: Atlas konyi luwo kaka kit ringruokni lokore e kindeni mar lokruok.

life_stage_menopause.description.luo: Atlas konyi luwo ranyisi mari bang' rumo dwe.

care_phase_observation.description.luo: Chak neno mari mokwongo mondo ichak wuodhi gi Atlas.

care_phase_care_outreach.description.luo: Manyo rit mari en achiel kuom ndikoni.

care_phase_atlas_record.description.luo: Ndikoni mar chakruok mar Atlas oikore. Timne Check-In e kinde mondo iluw kaka gik moloko.

care_phase_check_ins.description.luo: Check-Ins mari medo kido maduong' mar ndikoni.

care_phase_monitoring.description.luo: In e nono madhi nyime — Atlas medo gero ndikoni gi Check-In ka Check-In.

bleeding_burden.plainLanguageMeaning.luo: Atlas noneno ni olni nyalo dwaro ikruok mang'eny, teko, kod rit e ngima mapile.

bleeding_burden.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Pek mar ol en mar neno kende — oleroga gima iselimo, ok en ng'ado tuo.

bleeding_burden.whyConnected.luo: Atlas ochoko wechegi nikech dwoko moluwore gi ol nyalo chako kinde, lith remo, loko gige tich, kod ikruok mapile.

bleeding_burden.watchOverTime.luo: Ka ol osiko mana achiel, medore kata bedo mapok ng'ere, kata dhi nyime kod muoch chuny kod ikruok.

pain_distribution.plainLanguageMeaning.luo: Atlas noneno ni rem nyalo landore e kinde, wuoth, kod kaka idwoko ka obiro.

pain_distribution.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Kit rem en mar neno, ok en nying ma ng'ado tuo.

pain_distribution.whyConnected.luo: Atlas ochoko wechegi nikech kinde mar rem, kama en, dak, kod dwoko nyalo bedo gimoro achiel ma iselimo.

pain_distribution.watchOverTime.luo: Ka rem osiko mana kar achiel, landore e tije mamoko, kata bedo mayot ng'eyo motelo.

hormonal_rhythm.plainLanguageMeaning.luo: Atlas noneno ni kit dwe kod ranyisi mag hormone nyalo bedo gik machweyo kaka ringruokni fwenyore e kinde.

hormonal_rhythm.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Nenruok mar kit en ok ng'ado tuo mar hormone.

hormonal_rhythm.whyConnected.luo: Atlas ochoko wechegi nikech ng'eyo motelo mar dwe, ranyisi mag hormone, kod kinde mar tuoche nyalo wuoth kaachiel.

hormonal_rhythm.watchOverTime.luo: Ka kit dweni bedo maler moloyo, lokore mang'eny moloyo, kata luwore maler gi ranyisi mamoko mag ringruok.

pelvic_function.participantLabel.luo: Ranyisi mag Iye Piny kod Ringruok

pelvic_function.plainLanguageMeaning.luo: Atlas noneno ranyisi mag iye piny kata lokruok mar ringruok ma nyalo bedo moriwore, ok gimoro ka gimoro kende.

pelvic_function.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Ranyisi mag iye piny gin gik mochoki mag neno, ok tuo achiel.

pelvic_function.whyConnected.luo: Atlas ochoko wechegi nikech chandruok mar iye piny kod ranyisi mag lokruok mar ringruok nyalo nyiso chenro mar iye piny moriwore.

pelvic_function.watchOverTime.luo: Ka chandruokno osiko mabor mabor, bedo mosiko, kata luwore gi iye, thuno, kata wuoth.

daily_function.plainLanguageMeaning.luo: Atlas noneno ni tuoche nyalo miyo skul, tich, yweyo, kod tije ma inyalo timo lokore.

daily_function.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Gima omulo en ranyisi — odonjo e ndikoni ka tuoche loko ngima mapile.

daily_function.whyConnected.luo: Atlas ochoko wechegi nikech tije mokadho, nindo mochandi, kod gima omulo nyalo loko ngima mapile.

daily_function.watchOverTime.luo: Ka chenro bedo mothuolo moloyo, ochung' matek moloyo, kata bedo mayot ng'eyo motelo ka tuoche loko.

care_experience.plainLanguageMeaning.luo: Atlas noneno ni wuoth mari mar rit — yudo, dwoko, kod winjo ni owinji — en achiel kuom ndikoni.

care_experience.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Wuoth mar rit loso gima ng'ato luwo, weyo, kata weyo wacho.

care_experience.whyConnected.luo: Atlas ochoko wechegi nikech gilero kaka isewuotho gi rit kaachiel gi tuoche.

care_experience.watchOverTime.luo: Ka yudo rit, ler, kod winjo ni owinji dhi maber, chung, kata lokore e kinde.

body_unpredictability.plainLanguageMeani.luo: Atlas noneno ni ok ng'eyo gima biro timore bang'e nyalo chweyo kaka ichano kod iikori.

body_unpredictability.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Winjo ranyisi nyalo dwoko winjo ni tuoche gin mag apoya.

body_unpredictability.whyConnected.luo: Atlas ochoko wechegi nikech ok ng'ere nyalo chweyo chano, geno, kod ikruok mapile.

body_unpredictability.watchOverTime.luo: Ka ok ng'ere dwokore, lokore e bor mopogore, kata bedo mayot chano motelo.

planning_around_symptoms.plainLanguageMe.luo: Atlas noneno ni inyalo bedo ka ichano ngimani kuom kinde ma tuoche biroe.

planning_around_symptoms.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Pek mar chano en gima iselimo, ok kido mar chunyi.

planning_around_symptoms.whyConnected.luo: Atlas noneno dwaro mar chano konenore e neno mang'eny.

planning_around_symptoms.watchOverTime.luo: Ka pek mar chano dwokore kata bedo mayot ng'eyo motelo.

symptom_adaptation.plainLanguageMeaning.luo: Atlas noneno ni inyalo bedo ka iloso chenro mari mondo idag gi tuoche madhi nyime.

symptom_adaptation.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Winjruok en teko kendo ranyisi mar pek madhi nyime.

symptom_adaptation.whyConnected.luo: Atlas noneno loso chenro konenore kaachiel gi siko mar tuoche.

symptom_adaptation.watchOverTime.luo: Ka yore mag winjruok osiko mochung' kata lokore.

diagnostic_uncertainty.plainLanguageMean.luo: Atlas noneno ni bedo maonge dwoko maler nyalo bedo achiel kuom gima iselimo.

diagnostic_uncertainty.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Ok ng'ere nigi pek e ndiko mar gima iselimo.

diagnostic_uncertainty.whyConnected.luo: Atlas noneno ok ng'ere kuom gima ringruok timo.

diagnostic_uncertainty.watchOverTime.luo: Ka ler medore e neno mamoko.

care_navigation_complexity.plainLanguage.luo: Atlas noneno ni wuotho e yo mar rit nyalo dwaro tich mang'eny kod siko.

care_navigation_complexity.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Chandruok mar rit nyalo miyo gima iluwo kata iwacho lokore.

care_navigation_complexity.whyConnected.luo: Atlas noneno chandruok e kaka rit oseyud kendo orwako.

care_navigation_complexity.watchOverTime.luo: Ka yo mar rit bedo maler moloyo kata dongo mos.

life_reorganization.plainLanguageMeaning.luo: Atlas noneno ni tuoche nyalo loko tich, yweyo, wuoth, kod ngima mapile kaachiel.

life_reorganization.watchOverTime.luo: Ka chenro bedo mothuolo moloyo, ochung' matek moloyo, kata bedo mayot ng'eyo motelo ka tuoche loko.

life_reorganization.whyConnected.luo: Atlas noneno ni neno mang'eny nomulo chano, chenro, kod ikruok, ok mana tuoche achiel achiel.

life_reorganization.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Loko ngima leroga gima omulo, ok nying mar tuo achiel.

adaptive_living.plainLanguageMeaning.luo: Atlas noneno ka imanyo yore mag dak gi gima ringruoki timo.

adaptive_living.watchOverTime.luo: Ka yore mag winjruok osiko mochung' kata lokore.

adaptive_living.whyConnected.luo: Atlas noneno winjruok kod gima omulo ka wuotho kaachiel.

adaptive_living.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Winjruok nyiso teko manie i pek madhi nyime.

escalating_burden.plainLanguageMeaning.luo: Atlas noneno ranyisi ni tuoche nyalo dongo, ok mana siko mana achiel.

escalating_burden.watchOverTime.luo: Ka pek dongo, chung, kata dwokore.

escalating_burden.whyConnected.luo: Atlas noneno kit dhi marach e borni mopogore.

escalating_burden.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Dongruok en mar neno — neno mabiro biro miyo ler.

delayed_recognition.plainLanguageMeaning.luo: Atlas noneno ni yudo ler nyalo bedo ni nokawo kinde moloyo kaka nogeno.

delayed_recognition.watchOverTime.luo: Ka fweny kod ler mar rit dhi maber.

delayed_recognition.whyConnected.luo: Atlas noneno chandruok mar rit kaachiel gi ok ng'ere.

delayed_recognition.atlasNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Fweny mochwe en gima ojwang'ore kendo en adier.

_template.emergentAtlasNote.luo: Puonjni nowuok kaka neno mang'eny nochokore kaachiel — ok koa kuom dwoko achiel.

Bleeding Burden.explanation.luo: Ol nyalo dwarore nikech kaka omulo teko, ikruok, nindo, wuoth, kod chenro mapile, ok mana nikech ng'enyne.

Pain Distribution.explanation.luo: Rem sa moro ok bedo gimoro achiel kende. Onyalo konyo ka ineno kinde, wuoth, thuno, kod chenro mag iye piny kaachiel.

Pelvic Function.explanation.luo: Chandruok kata bedo mopong' nyalo winjore kaka gimoro achiel nyaka gineni kaachiel gi thuno, iye, wuoth, kata ranyisi mag lokruok mar ringruok.

Hormonal Rhythm.explanation.luo: Kit dwe en moloyo mana tarike. Lokruok mar kinde nyalo bedo kaachiel gi del, yier, teko, chuny, kata ranyisi mag lokruok mar ringruok.

Daily Function.explanation.luo: Chenro mar ringruok bedo maduong' moloyo ka ochako loko ngima mapile, kata bed ni tuo ka tuo winjore ni inyalo rito.

Life Reorganization.explanation.luo: Ka neno mang'eny ochokore kaachiel, tuoche nyalo loko tich, yweyo, wuoth, kod ngima mapile kaachiel.

Care Experience.explanation.luo: Winjo ni ok owinji kata onge dwoko nyalo loko kinde ma tuo osiko ma ok ondik, ma ok ochang, kata ma okawo kaka gima ojwang'ore.

Body Unpredictability.explanation.luo: Ok ng'eyo gima ringruoki biro timo bang'e nyalo bedo achiel kuom gima iselimo. Ok ng'ere nyalo mulo chano, geno mar kinde, kod manyo rit.

Bleeding Burden.literacyNote.luo: Fweny mar Atlas: Gima ol omulo ok en mana ng'enyne. Orwako yweyo, chenro, nindo, wuoth mabor, kod winjo ni oikore.

The Adapting Navigator.description.luo: Atlas neno ng'at ma loso ngima mapile ka opuonjore wuotho e ok ng'ere.

The Adapting Navigator.whatThisMeans.luo: Ranyisini fwenyore ka gik ma ringruok timo ochako mulo chano, ikruok, kod chenro. Chandruok maduong' ok en tuo achiel, to en dwaro mar winjruok gi ok ng'ere.

The Adapting Navigator.whyTemplate.luo: Atlas noyiero ranyisini nikech loko ngima, ok ng'ere mar ringruok, kod pek mar chano nofwenyore kaachiel e ndikoni.

The Adapting Navigator.logicSummary.luo: Kaachiel gigi nyiso gima ochung' kuom winjruok kod ikruok.

The Persistent Seeker.description.luo: Atlas neno siko mar manyo winjo gima timore kod yudo kony maler.

The Persistent Seeker.whatThisMeans.luo: Ranyisini fwenyore ka manyo ler kod kony bedo achiel kuom gima iselimo iwuon.

The Persistent Seeker.whyTemplate.luo: Atlas noyiero ranyisini nikech chandruok mar rit kod ok ng'ere mar ringruok nofwenyore kaachiel gi penjo madhi nyime kuom gima timore.

The Persistent Seeker.logicSummary.luo: Kaachiel gigi nyiso gima ochung' kuom siko kod manyo dwoko maler.

The Multi-System Experience.description.luo: Atlas neno gik ma nyalo luworore e rem, kit, chandruok, kod gima omulo ngima mapile.

The Multi-System Experience.whatThisMean.luo: Ranyisini fwenyore ka tuoche nyalo wuotho e chenro mang'eny mar ringruok kata ngima mapile kaachiel.

The Multi-System Experience.whyTemplate.luo: Atlas noyiero ranyisini nikech landruok mar rem, chandruok mar iye piny, kod ranyisi mag kit nofwenyore ka luworore e ndikoni.

The Multi-System Experience.logicSummary.luo: Kaachiel gigi nyiso gima nyalo winjore e chenro mang'eny mar ringruok kod ngima mapile.

The Uncertain Body Experience.descriptio.luo: Atlas neno ok ng'ere kod ranyisi mag ringruok molokore kaka gima iselimo maduong'.

The Uncertain Body Experience.whatThisMe.luo: Ranyisini fwenyore ka ok ng'eyo gima ringruok biro timo bang'e bedo achiel kuom pek.

The Uncertain Body Experience.whyTemplat.luo: Atlas noyiero ranyisini nikech ok ng'ere mar ringruok kod lokruok mar kit nofwenyore kaka puonj motegno moloyo e ndikoni.

The Uncertain Body Experience.logicSumma.luo: Kaachiel gigi nyiso gima ochung' kuom ok ng'ere kod ranyisi mag ringruok molokore.

The Body Negotiator.description.luo: Atlas neno riemb mosiko e kind dwaro mar ringruok, teko, kod gima ngima mapile dwaro.

The Body Negotiator.whatThisMeans.luo: Ranyisini fwenyore ka pek mar ringruok kod nyalo mar ngima mapile nyaka riembre kinde ka kinde.

The Body Negotiator.whyTemplate.luo: Atlas noyiero ranyisini nikech pek mar ol kod loko ngima nofwenyore kaachiel gi teko kod chandruok mar chenro.

The Body Negotiator.logicSummary.luo: Kaachiel gigi nyiso gima ochung' kuom riemb nyalo, teko, kod dwaro mapile.

The Quiet Burden.description.luo: Atlas neno pek mosiko ma nyalo bedo maonge nyisruok maduong', to nigi teko madier e ngima mapile.

The Quiet Burden.whatThisMeans.luo: Ranyisini fwenyore ka pek nitie kata obedo ni ndikoni ok ochung' kuom puonj achiel maduong'.

The Quiet Burden.whyTemplate.luo: Atlas noyiero ranyisini nikech ranyisi mag pek mar ringruok nofwenyore mosiko, kata maonge puonj achiel maduong'.

The Quiet Burden.logicSummary.luo: Kaachiel gigi nyiso pek molingo-lingo to madier monego onen e kinde.

Planning Burden.description.luo: Tich mopondo mar chano kuom ranyisi mag ringruok mayot ng'ere.

Life Constriction.reflectionText.luo: Gima iselimoni nyalo dwaro ni ineni gima osedok matek moloyo mondo iyaw e ngima mapile.

Body Predictability.reflectionText.luo: Gima iselimoni nyalo dwaro horuok ka Atlas puonjore gima osiko kod gima lokore.
